versions.changelog:
- Initial release of science-agent-compare skill.
- Enables side-by-side comparison of AI science agents by project names or research domain.
- Resolves same-name project collisions across 9 OpenClaw disambiguation groups.
- Presents structured comparison tables with key features, stars, tech stack, and use cases.
- Provides direct links to compare pages and full project listings.
- Offers clear recommendations based on user needs.
